====================================================================================================
ENG-1824: Use the unified upsert_concepts in Roam [Backlog] assignee=None
---------------------------------------- DESCRIPTION
## Problem

* Roam sync writes Concepts and Content in separate calls, to `upsert_concepts` and `upsert_content`. If one call fails, we have partially defined nodes in the database.
* It would be better to send the full node, with Content as sub-objects of the Concept, in a single upsert. `upsert_concepts` accepts this since [ENG-1822](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1822/modify-upsert-concepts-so-it-accepts-embedded-content).
* Roam publish already writes in a single call. Roam sync does not.

## Solution

* Remove the calls to `upsert_content`. Unify the Content computations to create the CrossAppNode type, and send it, after conversion, in a single call.

**Open decisions**

1. Does the single call go through the upsert route ([FEE-890](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/FEE-890/create-a-generic-upsert-route-that-accepts-all-root-crossapp-types)) or straight to `upsert_concepts`? On 2026-07-17 we agreed on the route. [FEE-890](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/FEE-890/create-a-generic-upsert-route-that-accepts-all-root-crossapp-types) has to confirm that still holds after v0.
2. [ENG-2165](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-2165/refactor-roam-sync-to-use-crossappnodes) (Roam sync onto the CrossApp converters) is the same work. Is it a step of this ticket, or does it replace this ticket? [ENG-2413](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-2413/decide-how-roam-and-obsidian-move-onto-the-crossapp-types) decides this.
3. If we use the route, does this ticket also move Roam publish to it? Publish calls `upsert_concepts` directly today, and no ticket covers moving it.

## Done When

* There is no `upsert_content` call left in the Roam codebase, including test harnesses.

## Out of Scope

## Notes

* Today's `upsert_content` calls: `syncDgNodesToSupabase.ts` (two calls) and `upsertNodesAsContentWithEmbeddings.ts`. Test harnesses: `fileReferenceHarness.ts` and `syncSharedNodeAssets.test.ts`.
* History:
  * 2026-05-30: Marc-Antoine created this as the Roam half of [ENG-1794](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1794/atomic-upsert-of-concept-and-content).
  * 2026-06-25: Marc-Antoine: "Best done after [ENG-1848](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/FEE-892/add-roam-full-markdown-content-variant-for-shared-nodes)" (now [FEE-892](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/FEE-892/add-roam-full-markdown-content-variant-for-shared-nodes)).
  * 2026-07-17 meeting: agreed to change this ticket to use the upsert route. [Roam](<https://roamresearch.com/#/app/discourse-graphs/page/PwfDU0VOA>) Until this rewrite, Out of Scope said "Going through the vercel endpoint."
---------------------------------------- COMMENT 2026-06-25 by Marc-Antoine Parent
Best done after [ENG-1848](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1848/add-roam-full-markdown-content-variant-for-shared-nodes)
---------------------------------------- COMMENT 2026-10-22 by siddharth yadav
Decision (Sid, 2026-10-22):

- Don't wait for FEE-890. Write each node in one `upsert_concepts` call, directly to the database. This departs from the 2026-07-17 agreement, because the route has no date. Moving Roam sync and publish onto the route comes later in its own tickets, so this ticket doesn't move publish.
- This ticket is a step of ENG-2165, which becomes the parent. It comes after ENG-2061 and converts through `CrossAppNode`, as its Solution says, so Roam sync and publish share one conversion.

Two things to cover with the single write, found in the review of PR #1570 (read from the code, not run):

FEE-890: Create a generic upsert route that accepts all root CrossApp types [Discovery] assignee=Marc-Antoine Parent
---------------------------------------- DESCRIPTION
## Problem

* Roam and Obsidian write to the database directly, by calling database functions such as `upsert_concepts` and `upsert_content`.
* In July we agreed the end goal is one upsert route in Next.js. It takes CrossApp types, does the conversions, and makes a single database upsert. [ENG-1909](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1909/add-no-op-nextjs-content-upsert-endpoint) gave the reason: plugins writing directly to Supabase makes future translation and versioning harder.
* Our first attempt, [ENG-1909](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1909/add-no-op-nextjs-content-upsert-endpoint), required awareness of the Content/Concept distinction, introduced StandaloneContent, and did not use the root CrossApp types. This ticket uses the root CrossApp types instead.

## Solution

* A generic upsert route that accepts all root CrossApp types and does the corresponding upsert.
* Callers go through an action-specific function, such as publish, that assembles the payload. They never call the route directly from the CrossApp contracts.

**Open decisions**

1. Is one upsert route still the goal after v0?
2. When a payload is missing a schema it depends on, does the route reject the payload or fetch the schema from the database? PR [DiscourseGraphs/discourse-graph#1237](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/review/eng-2039-create-a-generic-upsert-route-856267401e7a) fetches. Michael asked to reject. Rejecting would also avoid the extra database calls Michael asked about on 2026-07-20.
3. What is the route called? Michael suggested `/api/internal/space/[id]/graph/upsert`.
4. When the route fails, what can a user do with the error message?
5. Does "all aspects of upserting" include embeddings? Today they have their own route, `supabase/content-embedding`.

## Done When

* We can do all aspects of upserting nodes, relations and schemas with a single call to the upsert route.

## Out of Scope

* Adding accounts (could be added later)
* Optimizations

## Notes

* PR [DiscourseGraphs/discourse-graph#1237](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/review/eng-2039-create-a-generic-upsert-route-856267401e7a) (draft) is a first version. ENG-2091: Unify SharedNode and CrossAppNode [Backlog] assignee=None
---------------------------------------- DESCRIPTION
## Problem

* We have two types that represent an abstraction of a node, `SharedNode` (`packages/database/src/lib/sharedNodes.ts`) and `CrossAppNode` (`packages/database/src/crossAppContracts.ts`). This makes for a larger cognitive surface.
  * `SharedNode` is the discovery listing: what a user sees for the nodes in a shared space. It has no content body.
  * `CrossAppNode` is the write payload, with direct and full content.
* There are aspects of SharedNode that are missing from CrossAppNode:
  * ~~reference_content (missing)~~ Done: [ENG-2129](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-2129/populate-reference-content-from-crossappnode-and-roles-from) added `slots` to both types.
  * sourceId: unclear. `SharedNode.sourceLocalId` already maps to `CrossAppBase.localId`.
  * directMetadata: the direct Content row's `metadata`, not `literal_content`. Only Obsidian reads it, to get `filePath`.
  * Space and listing fields: `spaceId`, `spaceName`, `spaceUri`, `platform`, `schemaId` and the decorated `title`. Roam discovery and import use them.
* We have a lot of code that started using the SharedNode and will need refactoring: 8 files in `apps/roam/src`, and Obsidian's `getPublishedNodesForGroups` (`importNodes.ts`).

## Solution

* Add the missing fields to CrossAppNodes.
* Take the functions that create SharedNodes from database data, and create equivalent functions that create CrossAppNodes instead
  * No such function exists for nodes today. `dbToCrossAppConverters.ts` covers schemas and relations only.
* Start using those new functions in the client code
* Remove SharedNodes

**Open decisions**

1. Does discovery return `CrossAppNode`, or do we keep `SharedNode` as a separate listing type? Michael (2026-07-22) and Marc-Antoine (2026-08-03) pointed to `CrossAppNode`. Sid (2026-07-20) described `SharedNode` as a lightweight listing.
2. If discovery returns `CrossAppNode`, do the space and listing fields go into `CrossAppNode`, or into a listing type that wraps it (for example `{ node, space, schemaDbId, directMetadata }`)?
3. What did "sourceId" mean?
   1. Equivalent to sourceLocalId
4. Which ticket builds the database-to-`CrossAppNode` function for nodes: this one or [ENG-1985](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1985/define-converters-between-database-schemas-and-cross-app-schemas)?
5. [ENG-2045](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-2045/remove-obsidian-getpublishednodesforgroups-wrapper-consume-shared) moves Obsidian onto `SharedNode`. Does it wait for this ticket, or change its target?

## Done When

* We have removed SharedNodes without loss of functionality

## Out of Scope

* Adding functionality, adjacent refactors.

## Notes

* This ticket doesn't depend on the upsert route ([ENG-2412](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-2412/decide-the-upsert-path-for-roam-and-obsidian-writes)): discovery is a read path.
* History:
  * 2026-07-15 meeting: Michael: "create a task to update `CrossAppNode` and any callers to remove dbId". [Roam](<https://roamresearch.com/#/app/discourse-graphs/page/sYQ9O9CJj>) [ENG-2036](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-2036/remove-ref-from-the-cross-app-node-contract) ([DiscourseGraphs/discourse-graph#1235](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/review/eng-2036-simplify-the-cross-app-node-contract-057a05658547)) did this on 2026-07-16.
  * 2026-07-20: Michael on [DiscourseGraphs/discourse-graph#1216](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/review/eng-2019-extract-shared-cross-space-node-discovery-into-78b77fd1985a): "Are we planning on re-using a CrossApp contract for the return type?" [PR comment](<https://github.com/DiscourseGraphs/discourse-graph/pull/1216#discussion_r3611773589>)
  * 2026-07-20: Sid replied: "CrossApp contract is for the setters and getters converters … SharedNode is a lightweight listing of what a user sees for the nodes that are in shared space." He planned the getters for [ENG-1856](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1856/store-source-identity-metadata-for-roam-imported-nodes), which was released on 2026-07-27 without a node getter. [PR comment](<https://github.com/DiscourseGraphs/discourse-graph/pull/1216#discussion_r3613796080>)

[Roam](<https://roamresearch.com/#/app/discourse-graphs/page/AU5C3t2lh>) On main, `CrossAppBase` has no `spaceId`. [ENG-2050](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-2050/add-rid-optional-in-the-crossapp-base) ([DiscourseGraphs/discourse-graph#1282](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/review/eng-2050-re-introduce-rid-optional-in-the-crossapp-base-e3bf6bcad804), 2026-08-19) added an optional `rid`.
---------------------------------------- COMMENT 2026-10-22 by siddharth yadav
Decision: the ticket's Solution and Done When settle it. Discovery returns `CrossAppNode`, and `SharedNode` is removed. Sid agreed on 2026-10-22. His 2026-07-20 point about a light listing still holds: `content.full` is optional, and import fetches the full content on its own.

- Fields to add: every field a caller reads from the listing today, as the Solution says.

  - Also read today, and missed in the first version of this comment: `spaceUri` (Roam shows and filters on it; `rid` carries it but is optional), the node type's database id (Roam resolves node types by it in `resolveSharedNodeTypes.ts`), and the author's database account id (Obsidian's import modal shows author names from it).
  - `modifiedAt` has to stay the latest time of the Concept, the direct Content and the full Content, as `lastModified` is today, or refresh misses edits to a node's body.
  - The rest already exists in another form: `localId`, `content.direct.value`, the dates and `slots`.
- "sourceId": answered in this ticket as "Equivalent to sourceLocalId", which already maps to `localId`. Nothing to add.
- ENG-1985 builds the database-to-`CrossAppNode` converter for nodes, and this ticket uses it.
- ENG-2045 follows this ticket.

Open, needs Marc-Antoine: for the three missed fields, add each to `CrossAppNode`, or change its caller to the CrossApp form (a required `rid`, node types resolved by local id, author names looked up by local id).
---------------------------------------- COMMENT 2026-10-23 by Marc-Antoine Parent (reply)
I'm -1 on adding spaceId, spaceName, platform etc. to CrossApp. Note how we have not needed this otherwise so far. The supabase function upsert point has the spaceId in its parameters, and should only allow upsert of local concepts. The eventual vercel upsert point should also have the spaceId in the path. Anyway, in the upsert/sync path, we're always bound by the current spaceId as given in the supabaseContext. If we need to go beyond that, we have the RID field which holds enough information to identify the space.

directMetadata: This is intentionally an implementation grab-bag to minimize database migrations; and the decision so far has been to make every defined property explicit in CrossApp, so that the CrossApp does not need to know about this database implementation idiosyncrasy. So I think we should not add it to CrossApp. (I have it in crossAppSchemaBase, and that may have been a mistake.)

Anything we need to put there has to be explicitly added to CrossApp: This obviously applies to format and colour.

Another case that is important: Obsidian stores node instance frontmatter in the `source_data` variable. We need to expose that separately.

Obsidian also stores `label`, which... may have been needed to handle the name collision issue you raise? To be reviewed.

Name: May be worth using the full path minus the path of the discourse graph folder. Will resolve to just the name in many cases, but not when it matters. Does not need separate storage.

importedFromRid: imported instances are not re-exported, but schemas are. May be worth adding to DB for that reason. (May even be worth a column.) BUT I think it requires deeper design. An imported schema may be the synthesis of many imported schemas from different spaces. (See [https://roamresearch.com/#/app/discourse-graphs/page/IM2y99NZO](<https://roamresearch.com/#/app/discourse-graphs/page/IM2y99NZO>) and [https://roamresearch.com/#/app/discourse-graphs/page/w8k2RA1C0](<https://roamresearch.com/#/app/discourse-graphs/page/w8k2RA1C0>) for details.) Do we pick one, many? I have an intuition it may be tied to the design for collaborative documents, actually. In any case, no urgency to put it in the database.

ENG-2045: Remove Obsidian's getPublishedNodesForGroups wrapper and read CrossAppNode directly [Backlog] assignee=None
---------------------------------------- DESCRIPTION
## Problem

* Obsidian's `getPublishedNodesForGroups` (`apps/obsidian/src/utils/importNodes.ts:53`) is a thin wrapper over shared discovery. Its only job is remapping `SharedNode` to the local `PublishedNode` type (`:43`):
  * ISO strings (`created` / `lastModified`) → epoch numbers (`createdAt` / `modifiedAt`)
  * `directMetadata` (`Json`) → extracted `filePath: string | undefined`
* Michael on PR [DiscourseGraphs/discourse-graph#1216](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/review/eng-2019-extract-shared-cross-space-node-discovery-into-78b77fd1985a): "`getPublishedNodesForGroups` is now redundant. It looks like the only thing it is doing is adding `filePath`, which doesn't warrant an entire wrapped function."
* [ENG-2091](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-2091/unify-sharednode-and-crossappnode) replaces `SharedNode` with `CrossAppNode`. It can't remove `SharedNode` while this wrapper, Obsidian's only reader of shared discovery, still uses it.

## Solution

* Remove the `getPublishedNodesForGroups` wrapper and the local `PublishedNode` type. Have `ImportNodesModal` (and the `ImportableNode` conversion path) read `CrossAppNode` directly, moving the `filePath`-from-`directMetadata` extraction to the single call site that needs it.
* Do this as a sub-issue of [ENG-2091](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-2091/unify-sharednode-and-crossappnode): after [ENG-2091](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-2091/unify-sharednode-and-crossappnode) adds the discovery function that returns `CrossAppNode`, and before it removes `SharedNode`. The wrapper is then deleted once, not rewritten and then deleted.

**Open decisions**

1. The import dialog shows author names by the author's database account id (`ImportNodesModal.tsx:130`, `:371-373`; `typeUtils.ts:92-97`). Does `CrossAppNode` carry that id, or does Obsidian look names up by the account's local id? This is one of the three fields in [ENG-2091](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-2091/unify-sharednode-and-crossappnode)'s open question for Marc-Antoine.

## Done When

* `getPublishedNodesForGroups` and the local `PublishedNode` type are gone.
* Obsidian's import path reads `CrossAppNode` directly.
* A manual import in Obsidian lists the same nodes, titles, dates and author names as before. No automated test covers this path.

## Out of Scope

* Changing discovery itself ([ENG-2091](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-2091/unify-sharednode-and-crossappnode)).
* Obsidian sync's write path ([ENG-1986](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1986/refactor-obsidian-sync-to-use-the-new-cross-app-schemas)).

ENG-1985: Add a database-to-`CrossAppNode` converter for nodes [Backlog] assignee=Marc-Antoine Parent
---------------------------------------- DESCRIPTION
## Problem

* [ENG-1983](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1983/define-intermediate-schemas-for-node-relations-and-schemas) defined the CrossApp types. This ticket covers converting between them and the database.
* Done: the converters from CrossApp types to the database are on main in `crossAppConverters.ts` ([ENG-2003](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-2003/add-converter-for-crossappnode-to-localconceptdatainput), [ENG-2004](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-2004/add-converter-for-crossappnode-to-localcontentdatainput), [ENG-2017](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-2017/add-converter-for-crossapp-schemas-to-localconceptdatainput), [ENG-2018](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-2018/add-converter-for-crossapprelation-schema-to-localconceptdatainput)). [ENG-2146](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-2146/bulk-convert-some-db-structures-to-crossapp-structures-as-needed-for) added the converters from the database to CrossApp types for schemas and relations in `dbToCrossAppConverters.ts`.
* Missing: nothing converts database rows to `CrossAppNode`. Discovery builds `SharedNode` by hand instead (`buildSharedNodes` in `sharedNodes.ts`). [ENG-2091](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-2091/unify-sharednode-and-crossappnode) needs this converter to return `CrossAppNode` from discovery and remove `SharedNode`.

## Solution

* Add a converter from database rows to `CrossAppNode`, and its bulk form, next to `dbNodeSchemaToCrossApp` in `dbToCrossAppConverters.ts`.
* Cover the fields `CrossAppNode` has on main. [ENG-2091](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-2091/unify-sharednode-and-crossappnode) adds its new fields to the converter when it adds them to the type.
* Take the rows discovery already reads, with `content.full` optional. `modifiedAt` is the latest `last_modified` of the Concept, the direct Content and the full Content, as `lastModified` is today.

**Open decisions**

1. What does the converter do with a row the contract can't represent, such as one with no author, no created date or no core title? Discovery skips some incomplete rows (`sharedNodes.ts:165-195`) but keeps nodes without an author (`sharedNodes.ts:235`), while `CrossAppNode` requires `authorId`. The schema converter throws instead (`dbToCrossAppConverters.ts:105-108`), and in a listing one throw hides every node.

## Done When

* A converter from database rows to `CrossAppNode` exists in `dbToCrossAppConverters.ts`.
* Unit tests cover slots in the same space and across spaces, the latest-of-three `modifiedAt`, and the rule for incomplete rows.

## Out of Scope

* Refactor the existing sync code to use converters.
* Switching discovery and its callers to `CrossAppNode` ([ENG-2091](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-2091/unify-sharednode-and-crossappnode)).

## Notes

* Draft PR [DiscourseGraphs/discourse-graph#1184](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/review/eng-1985-define-converters-between-database-schemas-and-cross-app-df0fd187d781) is obsolete.   * 2026-07-20: Sid planned the database-to-CrossApp getters for [ENG-1856](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1856/store-source-identity-metadata-for-roam-imported-nodes) on PR [DiscourseGraphs/discourse-graph#1216](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/review/eng-2019-extract-shared-cross-space-node-discovery-into-78b77fd1985a). ENG-2091: Unify SharedNode and CrossAppNode [Backlog] assignee=None
---------------------------------------- DESCRIPTION
## Problem

* We have two types that represent an abstraction of a node, `SharedNode` (`packages/database/src/lib/sharedNodes.ts`) and `CrossAppNode` (`packages/database/src/crossAppContracts.ts`). This makes for a larger cognitive surface.
  * `SharedNode` is the discovery listing: what a user sees for the nodes in a shared space. It has no content body.
  * `CrossAppNode` is the write payload, with direct and full content.
* There are aspects of SharedNode that are missing from CrossAppNode:
  * ~~reference_content (missing)~~ Done: [ENG-2129](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-2129/populate-reference-content-from-crossappnode-and-roles-from) added `slots` to both types.
  * sourceId: unclear. `SharedNode.sourceLocalId` already maps to `CrossAppBase.localId`.
  * directMetadata: the direct Content row's `metadata`, not `literal_content`. Only Obsidian reads it, to get `filePath`.
  * Space and listing fields: `spaceId`, `spaceName`, `spaceUri`, `platform`, `schemaId` and the decorated `title`. Roam discovery and import use them.
* We have a lot of code that started using the SharedNode and will need refactoring: 8 files in `apps/roam/src`, and Obsidian's `getPublishedNodesForGroups` (`importNodes.ts`).

## Solution

* Add the missing fields to CrossAppNodes.
* Take the functions that create SharedNodes from database data, and create equivalent functions that create CrossAppNodes instead
  * No such function exists for nodes today. `dbToCrossAppConverters.ts` covers schemas and relations only.
* Start using those new functions in the client code
* Remove SharedNodes

**Open decisions**

1. Does discovery return `CrossAppNode`, or do we keep `SharedNode` as a separate listing type? Michael (2026-07-22) and Marc-Antoine (2026-08-03) pointed to `CrossAppNode`. Sid (2026-07-20) described `SharedNode` as a lightweight listing.
2. If discovery returns `CrossAppNode`, do the space and listing fields go into `CrossAppNode`, or into a listing type that wraps it (for example `{ node, space, schemaDbId, directMetadata }`)?
3. What did "sourceId" mean?
   1. Equivalent to sourceLocalId
4. Which ticket builds the database-to-`CrossAppNode` function for nodes: this one or [ENG-1985](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1985/define-converters-between-database-schemas-and-cross-app-schemas)?
5. [ENG-2045](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-2045/remove-obsidian-getpublishednodesforgroups-wrapper-consume-shared) moves Obsidian onto `SharedNode`. Does it wait for this ticket, or change its target?

## Done When

* We have removed SharedNodes without loss of functionality

## Out of Scope

* Adding functionality, adjacent refactors.

## Notes

* This ticket doesn't depend on the upsert route ([ENG-2412](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-2412/decide-the-upsert-path-for-roam-and-obsidian-writes)): discovery is a read path.
* History:
  * 2026-07-15 meeting: Michael: "create a task to update `CrossAppNode` and any callers to remove dbId". [Roam](<https://roamresearch.com/#/app/discourse-graphs/page/sYQ9O9CJj>) [ENG-2036](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-2036/remove-ref-from-the-cross-app-node-contract) ([DiscourseGraphs/discourse-graph#1235](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/review/eng-2036-simplify-the-cross-app-node-contract-057a05658547)) did this on 2026-07-16.

[PR comment](<https://github.com/DiscourseGraphs/discourse-graph/pull/1216#discussion_r3611773589>)
  * 2026-07-20: Sid replied: "CrossApp contract is for the setters and getters converters … SharedNode is a lightweight listing of what a user sees for the nodes that are in shared space." He planned the getters for [ENG-1856](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1856/store-source-identity-metadata-for-roam-imported-nodes), which was released on 2026-07-27 without a node getter. [PR comment](<https://github.com/DiscourseGraphs/discourse-graph/pull/1216#discussion_r3613796080>)

[Roam](<https://roamresearch.com/#/app/discourse-graphs/page/AU5C3t2lh>) On main, `CrossAppBase` has no `spaceId`. [ENG-2050](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-2050/add-rid-optional-in-the-crossapp-base) ([DiscourseGraphs/discourse-graph#1282](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/review/eng-2050-re-introduce-rid-optional-in-the-crossapp-base-e3bf6bcad804), 2026-08-19) added an optional `rid`.

Decision: the ticket's Solution and Done When settle it. Discovery returns `CrossAppNode`, and `SharedNode` is removed. Sid agreed on 2026-10-22. His 2026-07-20 point about a light listing still holds: `content.full` is optional, and import fetches the full content on its own.

Open, needs Marc-Antoine: for the three missed fields, add each to `CrossAppNode`, or change its caller to the CrossApp form (a required `rid`, node types resolved by local id, author names looked up by local id).
---------------------------------------- COMMENT 2026-10-23 by Marc-Antoine Parent (reply)
I'm -1 on adding spaceId, spaceName, platform etc. to CrossApp. Note how we have not needed this otherwise so far. The supabase function upsert point has the spaceId in its parameters, and should only allow upsert of local concepts. The eventual vercel upsert point should also have the spaceId in the path. Anyway, in the upsert/sync path, we're always bound by the current spaceId as given in the supabaseContext. If we need to go beyond that, we have the RID field which holds enough information to identify the space.

directMetadata: This is intentionally an implementation grab-bag to minimize database migrations; and the decision so far has been to make every defined property explicit in CrossApp, so that the CrossApp does not need to know about this database implementation idiosyncrasy. So I think we should not add it to CrossApp. (I have it in crossAppSchemaBase, and that may have been a mistake.)

Anything we need to put there has to be explicitly added to CrossApp: This obviously applies to format and colour.

Another case that is important: Obsidian stores node instance frontmatter in the `source_data` variable. We need to expose that separately.

Obsidian also stores `label`, which... may have been needed to handle the name collision issue you raise? To be reviewed.

Name: May be worth using the full path minus the path of the discourse graph folder. Will resolve to just the name in many cases, but not when it matters. Does not need separate storage.

importedFromRid: imported instances are not re-exported, but schemas are. May be worth adding to DB for that reason. (May even be worth a column.) BUT I think it requires deeper design. An imported schema may be the synthesis of many imported schemas from different spaces. (See [https://roamresearch.com/#/app/discourse-graphs/page/IM2y99NZO](<https://roamresearch.com/#/app/discourse-graphs/page/IM2y99NZO>) and [https://roamresearch.com/#/app/discourse-graphs/page/w8k2RA1C0](<https://roamresearch.com/#/app/discourse-graphs/page/w8k2RA1C0>) for details.) Do we pick one, many? I have an intuition it may be tied to the design for collaborative documents, actually. In any case, no urgency to put it in the database.

ENG-2045: Remove Obsidian's getPublishedNodesForGroups wrapper and read CrossAppNode directly [Backlog] assignee=None
---------------------------------------- DESCRIPTION
## Problem

* Obsidian's `getPublishedNodesForGroups` (`apps/obsidian/src/utils/importNodes.ts:53`) is a thin wrapper over shared discovery. Its only job is remapping `SharedNode` to the local `PublishedNode` type (`:43`):
  * ISO strings (`created` / `lastModified`) → epoch numbers (`createdAt` / `modifiedAt`)
  * `directMetadata` (`Json`) → extracted `filePath: string | undefined`
* Michael on PR [DiscourseGraphs/discourse-graph#1216](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/review/eng-2019-extract-shared-cross-space-node-discovery-into-78b77fd1985a): "`getPublishedNodesForGroups` is now redundant. It looks like the only thing it is doing is adding `filePath`, which doesn't warrant an entire wrapped function."
* [ENG-2091](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-2091/unify-sharednode-and-crossappnode) replaces `SharedNode` with `CrossAppNode`. It can't remove `SharedNode` while this wrapper, Obsidian's only reader of shared discovery, still uses it.

## Solution

* Remove the `getPublishedNodesForGroups` wrapper and the local `PublishedNode` type. Have `ImportNodesModal` (and the `ImportableNode` conversion path) read `CrossAppNode` directly, moving the `filePath`-from-`directMetadata` extraction to the single call site that needs it.
* Do this as a sub-issue of [ENG-2091](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-2091/unify-sharednode-and-crossappnode): after [ENG-2091](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-2091/unify-sharednode-and-crossappnode) adds the discovery function that returns `CrossAppNode`, and before it removes `SharedNode`. The wrapper is then deleted once, not rewritten and then deleted.

**Open decisions**

1. The import dialog shows author names by the author's database account id (`ImportNodesModal.tsx:130`, `:371-373`; `typeUtils.ts:92-97`). Does `CrossAppNode` carry that id, or does Obsidian look names up by the account's local id? This is one of the three fields in [ENG-2091](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-2091/unify-sharednode-and-crossappnode)'s open question for Marc-Antoine.

## Done When

* `getPublishedNodesForGroups` and the local `PublishedNode` type are gone.
* Obsidian's import path reads `CrossAppNode` directly.
* A manual import in Obsidian lists the same nodes, titles, dates and author names as before. No automated test covers this path.

## Out of Scope

* Changing discovery itself ([ENG-2091](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-2091/unify-sharednode-and-crossappnode)).
* Obsidian sync's write path ([ENG-1986](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1986/refactor-obsidian-sync-to-use-the-new-cross-app-schemas)).

## Notes

* Current state: the wrapper's only caller is `ImportNodesModal.tsx:69`. A comment at `apps/obsidian/src/types.ts:103` still names the wrapper.
* History:
  * 2026-07-20: Michael on PR [DiscourseGraphs/discourse-graph#1216](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/review/eng-2019-extract-shared-cross-space-node-discovery-into-78b77fd1985a): "`getPublishedNodesForGroups` is now redundant." [PR comment](<https://github.com/DiscourseGraphs/discourse-graph/pull/1216#discussion_r3611738812>) Also: "Are we planning on re-using a CrossApp contract for the return type?" [PR comment](<https://github.com/DiscourseGraphs/discourse-graph/pull/1216#discussion_r3611773589>)
  * 2026-07-20: Sid created this ticket to keep PR [DiscourseGraphs/discourse-graph#1216](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/review/eng-2019-extract-shared-cross-space-node-discovery-into-78b77fd1985a) a pure extraction, and replied that `SharedNode` is "a lightweight listing of what a user sees for the nodes that are in shared space." [PR comment](<https://github.com/DiscourseGraphs/discourse-graph/pull/1216#discussion_r3613796080>)
  * 2026-07-22: Michael on PR [DiscourseGraphs/discourse-graph#1216](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/review/eng-2019-extract-shared-cross-space-node-discovery-into-78b77fd1985a): "eventually should be CrossAppNode contract, but that can be defered to the next project". [PR comment](<https://github.com/DiscourseGraphs/discourse-graph/pull/1216#discussion_r3632617180>)
  * 2026-10-22: Sid decided this ticket waits for [ENG-2091](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-2091/unify-sharednode-and-crossappnode) and reads its type.

Decision (Sid, 2026-10-22): ENG-2091 replaces `SharedNode` with `CrossAppNode` plus the missing fields. Obsidian's import should use that type, so this ticket waits for ENG-2091. Its Done When already allows "the agreed cross-app return type".

ENG-1985: Add a database-to-`CrossAppNode` converter for nodes [Backlog] assignee=Marc-Antoine Parent
---------------------------------------- DESCRIPTION
## Problem

* [ENG-1983](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1983/define-intermediate-schemas-for-node-relations-and-schemas) defined the CrossApp types. This ticket covers converting between them and the database.
* Done: the converters from CrossApp types to the database are on main in `crossAppConverters.ts` ([ENG-2003](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-2003/add-converter-for-crossappnode-to-localconceptdatainput), [ENG-2004](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-2004/add-converter-for-crossappnode-to-localcontentdatainput), [ENG-2017](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-2017/add-converter-for-crossapp-schemas-to-localconceptdatainput), [ENG-2018](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-2018/add-converter-for-crossapprelation-schema-to-localconceptdatainput)). [ENG-2146](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-2146/bulk-convert-some-db-structures-to-crossapp-structures-as-needed-for) added the converters from the database to CrossApp types for schemas and relations in `dbToCrossAppConverters.ts`.
* Missing: nothing converts database rows to `CrossAppNode`. Discovery builds `SharedNode` by hand instead (`buildSharedNodes` in `sharedNodes.ts`). [ENG-2091](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-2091/unify-sharednode-and-crossappnode) needs this converter to return `CrossAppNode` from discovery and remove `SharedNode`.

## Solution

* Add a converter from database rows to `CrossAppNode`, and its bulk form, next to `dbNodeSchemaToCrossApp` in `dbToCrossAppConverters.ts`.
* Cover the fields `CrossAppNode` has on main. [ENG-2091](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-2091/unify-sharednode-and-crossappnode) adds its new fields to the converter when it adds them to the type.
* Take the rows discovery already reads, with `content.full` optional. `modifiedAt` is the latest `last_modified` of the Concept, the direct Content and the full Content, as `lastModified` is today.

**Open decisions**

1. What does the converter do with a row the contract can't represent, such as one with no author, no created date or no core title? Discovery skips some incomplete rows (`sharedNodes.ts:165-195`) but keeps nodes without an author (`sharedNodes.ts:235`), while `CrossAppNode` requires `authorId`. The schema converter throws instead (`dbToCrossAppConverters.ts:105-108`), and in a listing one throw hides every node.

## Done When

* A converter from database rows to `CrossAppNode` exists in `dbToCrossAppConverters.ts`.
* Unit tests cover slots in the same space and across spaces, the latest-of-three `modifiedAt`, and the rule for incomplete rows.

## Out of Scope

* Refactor the existing sync code to use converters.
* Switching discovery and its callers to `CrossAppNode` ([ENG-2091](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-2091/unify-sharednode-and-crossappnode)).

## Notes

* Draft PR [DiscourseGraphs/discourse-graph#1184](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/review/eng-1985-define-converters-between-database-schemas-and-cross-app-df0fd187d781) is obsolete. It targets the [ENG-1983](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1983/define-intermediate-schemas-for-node-relations-and-schemas) branch and adds converters to the database that main now has in another form, so it can be closed.
* History:
  * 2026-07-01: Marc-Antoine created this ticket. He opened draft PR [DiscourseGraphs/discourse-graph#1184](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/review/eng-1985-define-converters-between-database-schemas-and-cross-app-df0fd187d781) on 2026-07-02.
  * 2026-07-06: Michael on this ticket: "We'll break this into sub PR's to handle only the required converters at this time". In that day's meeting notes, right after this ticket, he typed: "let's only introduce new code only when we need it". [Roam](<https://roamresearch.com/#/app/discourse-graphs/page/q5T9hG7i2>)
  * 2026-07-20: Sid planned the database-to-CrossApp getters for [ENG-1856](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1856/store-source-identity-metadata-for-roam-imported-nodes) on PR [DiscourseGraphs/discourse-graph#1216](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/review/eng-2019-extract-shared-cross-space-node-discovery-into-78b77fd1985a). [ENG-1856](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1856/store-source-identity-metadata-for-roam-imported-nodes) was released without a node getter. [PR comment](<https://github.com/DiscourseGraphs/discourse-graph/pull/1216#discussion_r3613796080>)
  * 2026-08-21: [ENG-2146](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-2146/bulk-convert-some-db-structures-to-crossapp-structures-as-needed-for) (PR [DiscourseGraphs/discourse-graph#1300](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/review/eng-2146-bulk-convert-some-db-structures-to-crossapp-structures-as-8873a9645b6d), Marc-Antoine) added the converters from the database for schemas and relations.

---------------------------------------- DESCRIPTION
## Problem

* We have two paths to write to the database: sync and publish. They use different converters, which violates DRY.
  * Sync converts with `discourseNodeSchemaToLocalConcept`, `discourseNodeBlockToLocalConcept`, `convertRoamNodeToLocalContent` and `convertRoamNodeToFullContent`. It writes with `upsert_concepts` and `upsert_content` (`syncDgNodesToSupabase.ts`).
  * Publish converts with `crossAppNodeToDbConcept` and writes with `upsert_concepts` (`publishNodesToGroups.ts`).
* We want the sync to use the same CrossApp converters as publish.

## Solution

* Large-scale: Rewrite the sync to use the publish converters.
  * To be broken down in sub-tasks
* PR [DiscourseGraphs/discourse-graph#1333](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/review/eng-2165-refactor-roam-sync-to-use-crossappnodes-70d99b932447) is not code I think we should check in as-is, but Claude-generated code which I sent to help us understand the scope and surface.

**Open decisions**

1. Is this ticket a step of [ENG-1824](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1824/use-the-unified-upsert-concepts-in-roam), or does it replace [ENG-1824](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1824/use-the-unified-upsert-concepts-in-roam)?
   * As a step, this ticket moves sync onto the Roam-to-CrossApp converters and keeps the current write calls. [ENG-1824](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1824/use-the-unified-upsert-concepts-in-roam) then makes the single write.
   * This answers [ENG-1824](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1824/use-the-unified-upsert-concepts-in-roam)'s Open decision 2.
2. Which smaller tickets does [DiscourseGraphs/discourse-graph#1333](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/review/eng-2165-refactor-roam-sync-to-use-crossappnodes-70d99b932447) split into, and in what order? Michael asked for the split on 2026-08-28.
3. Do the items [DiscourseGraphs/discourse-graph#1333](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/review/eng-2165-refactor-roam-sync-to-use-crossappnodes-70d99b932447) deferred get their own tickets? They are `nodeTypeSince` missing child-block edits, and published isFirstChild nodes needing both a `direct_and_description` and a `direct` Content.

## Done When

* The old sync path using RoamFullContentNode is removed.
  * This will include [ENG-2061](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-2061/refactor-roamfullcontentnode-to-use-crossappnode-contract)
* The sync path only upserts Concepts, with embedded Content, vs the two phases we have now.
  * [ENG-1794](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1794/atomic-upsert-of-concept-and-content)
  * [ENG-1824](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1824/use-the-unified-upsert-concepts-in-roam) has the same Done When. Open decision 1 decides which ticket owns it.

## Out of Scope

* Moving Roam publish to the upsert route. [ENG-1824](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1824/use-the-unified-upsert-concepts-in-roam)'s Open decision 3 covers it.

  * If the upsert route stays the goal ([FEE-890](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/FEE-890/create-a-generic-upsert-route-that-accepts-all-root-crossapp-types)), sync only converts Roam data to CrossApp types, and the route converts them to database rows.
  * The sync schema converter now writes `template_content` (`conceptConversion.ts`), so the "template key" problem in the investigation below looks fixed on main.
* We still need to handle the discrepancy between direct and direct_and_description
  * Separate task but describing here
  * Published nodes with isFirst child need both to be maintained by sync
    * In sync, we can put the direct_and_description variant in the direct field of the Content (for isFirstChild nodes)

---------------------------------------- DESCRIPTION

## Solution

**Open decisions**

Is this the first sub-ticket of [ENG-2165](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-2165/refactor-roam-sync-to-use-crossappnodes), part of [ENG-2165](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-2165/refactor-roam-sync-to-use-crossappnodes)'s single change, or closed because `RoamFullContentNode` is a fair input row type?

[DiscourseGraphs/discourse-graph#1333](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/review/eng-2165-refactor-roam-sync-to-use-crossappnodes-70d99b932447) removed the type but deferred "Producers returning CrossAppNode directly".

## Out of Scope

* Changing the sync write calls ([ENG-1824](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1824/use-the-unified-upsert-concepts-in-roam)).

## Notes

* Current state: the type is used in `syncDgNodesToSupabase.ts`, `roamToCrossAppConverters.ts` and `__tests__/syncSharedNodeAssets.test.ts`. ENG-1986: Refactor Obsidian sync to use the new cross-app schemas [Backlog] assignee=None
---------------------------------------- DESCRIPTION
## Problem

* We will know that our cross-app schema is feature complete when we know that factoring translation through the cross-app converters handles all the cases of the existing direct database schema conversion.
* Obsidian sync doesn't use the CrossApp types today. It converts with its own functions (`apps/obsidian/src/utils/conceptConversion.ts`) and writes with `upsert_concepts` (`syncDgNodesToSupabase.ts`) and `upsert_content` (`upsertNodesAsContentWithEmbeddings.ts`).
* Obsidian publish writes only `ResourceAccess`, so Obsidian has a single write path. The duplicate converters are between Roam and Obsidian, not inside Obsidian.

## Solution

Rewrite the obsidian sync to use the cross-app schema.

**Open decisions**

1. Is this ticket a step of [ENG-1823](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1823/use-the-unified-upsert-concepts-in-obsidian), or does it replace [ENG-1823](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1823/use-the-unified-upsert-concepts-in-obsidian)? This answers [ENG-1823](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1823/use-the-unified-upsert-concepts-in-obsidian)'s Open decision 2. It depends on [FEE-890](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/FEE-890/create-a-generic-upsert-route-that-accepts-all-root-crossapp-types): a route that only accepts CrossApp types needs Obsidian sync on the CrossApp converters.
2. If we drop the upsert route, do we still do this ticket? Its remaining value would be checking that the CrossApp types are complete.
3. Is "[ENG-1985](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1985/define-converters-between-database-schemas-and-cross-app-schemas) blocks [ENG-1986](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1986/refactor-obsidian-sync-to-use-the-new-cross-app-schemas)" still true? The CrossApp-to-database converters for all six types are on main (`packages/database/src/lib/crossAppConverters.ts`).
4. Which Obsidian fields does "feature complete" cover? Candidates: `literal_content.importedFromRid` (possibly `CrossAppBase.rid`), `name` set from `file.path`, and the open "should we add colour? format?" comment on `CrossAppRelationTypeSchema`.

## Done When

We have refactored the Obsidian sync through the cross-app converters, without loss of functionality, ensuring that the cross-app schemas are complete

Tests cover the `direct` and `full` Content and the source identity that Obsidian sync writes. Nothing tests that upload today (`upsertNodesAsContentWithEmbeddings.ts:61`, `:72`).

## Out of Scope

Improvements to the sync process.

## Notes

* History:
  * 2026-07-01: Marc-Antoine created this ticket.
  * 2026-07-06 dev meeting: Marc-Antoine planned "Finish [ENG-1985](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1985/define-converters-between-database-schemas-and-cross-app-schemas)", then "Then [ENG-1986](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1986/refactor-obsidian-sync-to-use-the-new-cross-app-schemas)". Michael: "likely postponed", and "depends on \[\[Project/Push and pull nodes between Roam and Obsidian\]\] that doesn't block sid". [Roam](<https://roamresearch.com/#/app/discourse-graphs/page/d8NuLcxhb>) [Roam](<https://roamresearch.com/#/app/discourse-graphs/page/gF5B-qXfN>)
  * 2026-07-17 meeting: agreed that [ENG-1823](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1823/use-the-unified-upsert-concepts-in-obsidian) uses the upsert route. [Roam](<https://roamresearch.com/#/app/discourse-graphs/page/eY9Br5T7n>)
  * 2026-07-22 meeting: Michael noted "updated and organized" under this ticket. [Roam](<https://roamresearch.com/#/app/discourse-graphs/page/fMNY_jZud>)
---------------------------------------- COMMENT 2026-10-22 by siddharth yadav
Decision (Sid, 2026-10-22):

- Separate from ENG-1823, and later: this comes before Obsidian moves onto the upsert route. Obsidian has one write path, so there's no drift to fix before then.
- Still needed, because the upsert route stays the goal.
- ENG-1985 no longer blocks this. The CrossApp-to-database converters it needs are on main (`packages/database/src/lib/crossAppConverters.ts`).

Open, needs Marc-Antoine: which Obsidian fields the CrossApp types must cover. Candidates: `importedFromRid` (possibly `CrossAppBase.rid`), colour and format on relation types, and the Concept name. Obsidian names each Concept by its file path, while the shared converter uses the title, and Concept names are unique within a space. So two notes with the same title in different folders would collide (read from the code, not run).
---------------------------------------- COMMENT 2026-10-23 by siddharth yadav
Decision (Sid, 2026-10-23): Done When gains tests for the `direct` and `full` Content and the source identity that Obsidian sync writes. Nothing tests that upload today, and this ticket rewrites it, so the tests land with the change. From the ENG-1879 review under ENG-2429.

ENG-1986: Refactor Obsidian sync to use the new cross-app schemas [Backlog] assignee=None
---------------------------------------- DESCRIPTION
## Problem

* We will know that our cross-app schema is feature complete when we know that factoring translation through the cross-app converters handles all the cases of the existing direct database schema conversion.
* Obsidian sync doesn't use the CrossApp types today. It converts with its own functions (`apps/obsidian/src/utils/conceptConversion.ts`) and writes with `upsert_concepts` (`syncDgNodesToSupabase.ts`) and `upsert_content` (`upsertNodesAsContentWithEmbeddings.ts`).
* Obsidian publish writes only `ResourceAccess`, so Obsidian has a single write path. The duplicate converters are between Roam and Obsidian, not inside Obsidian.

## Solution

Rewrite the obsidian sync to use the cross-app schema.

**Open decisions**

1. Is this ticket a step of [ENG-1823](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1823/use-the-unified-upsert-concepts-in-obsidian), or does it replace [ENG-1823](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1823/use-the-unified-upsert-concepts-in-obsidian)? This answers [ENG-1823](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1823/use-the-unified-upsert-concepts-in-obsidian)'s Open decision 2. It depends on [FEE-890](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/FEE-890/create-a-generic-upsert-route-that-accepts-all-root-crossapp-types): a route that only accepts CrossApp types needs Obsidian sync on the CrossApp converters.
2. If we drop the upsert route, do we still do this ticket? Its remaining value would be checking that the CrossApp types are complete.
3. Is "[ENG-1985](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1985/define-converters-between-database-schemas-and-cross-app-schemas) blocks [ENG-1986](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1986/refactor-obsidian-sync-to-use-the-new-cross-app-schemas)" still true? The CrossApp-to-database converters for all six types are on main (`packages/database/src/lib/crossAppConverters.ts`).
4. Which Obsidian fields does "feature complete" cover? Candidates: `literal_content.importedFromRid` (possibly `CrossAppBase.rid`), `name` set from `file.path`, and the open "should we add colour? format?" comment on `CrossAppRelationTypeSchema`.

## Done When

We have refactored the Obsidian sync through the cross-app converters, without loss of functionality, ensuring that the cross-app schemas are complete

Tests cover the `direct` and `full` Content and the source identity that Obsidian sync writes. Nothing tests that upload today (`upsertNodesAsContentWithEmbeddings.ts:61`, `:72`).

## Out of Scope

Improvements to the sync process.

====================================================================================================
ENG-1866: Validate Obsidian relation export against the shared contract [Backlog] assignee=None
---------------------------------------- DESCRIPTION
## Problem

* Obsidian relation publishing is the reference behavior, but it needs validation against the cross-app relation contract.
* Any mismatch should be identified before Roam relies on the same relation shape.

## Solution

* Inspect existing Obsidian published relation schemas and relation instances.
* Validate labels, complements, roles, endpoint typing, stable identities, and endpoint bindings.
* Capture gaps as follow-up tickets rather than creating a new Obsidian relation export path.

## Done When

* Existing Obsidian relation export satisfies the [ENG-1863](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1863/define-cross-app-relation-contract-and-fixtures) contract or gaps are documented.
* Validation covers one relation schema and one relation instance with both endpoints shared.
* No new Obsidian relation transport format is introduced.

## Out of Scope

* Roam relation publishing or import.
* Obsidian relation importer changes.
* Relation acceptance UI.

## Notes

* Functional requirements: [F5: Relation schema and instance sharing](<https://roamresearch.com/#/app/discourse-graphs/page/gs-lxH5H3>), [F9: Stable cross-app identity](<https://roamresearch.com/#/app/discourse-graphs/page/914EWeU_9>).
* Depends on [ENG-1863](<https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1863/define-cross-app-relation-contract-and-fixtures>).
* Reuse Obsidian’s existing published-relation rule where practical.
---------------------------------------- COMMENT 2026-10-22 by siddharth yadav
Decision (Sid, 2026-10-22): close this. The validation it asked for happened in other tickets:

- Roam imports Obsidian's relations through the CrossApp converters (ENG-1867, ENG-2340).
- `dbToCrossAppConverters.test.ts` covers relation types, both forms of triple schema, and endpoints in other spaces.
- The one mismatch found, Obsidian relations pointing at a relation type instead of a triple, is handled by the shared matching rule (ENG-2373).

ENG-1863's fixtures never landed. They'd come back only as a regression test. Closing this ticket removes its block on ENG-1874.

ENG-2394: Choose how Obsidian retrieves relations made elsewhere between its own nodes [Backlog] assignee=None
---------------------------------------- DESCRIPTION
## Problem

* The source reports no way to import another app’s relation between two nodes the user created. Its linked test steps contain mistaken user/node references, so the exact test setup needs confirmation.
* A vault does not import its own nodes, so an imported-node-triggered lookup does not discover new relations between them.
* To repro:
  * User A publishes `node A` and `node B`
  * User B imports
  * User B creates relation between `node A` and `node B`
  * How does user A import said relation

## Solution

* Reconcile the October 8 test with [bxo-uDEeK](<https://roamresearch.com/#/app/discourse-graphs/page/bxo-uDEeK>) and the explicit exclusion in [ENG-2338](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-2338/import-cross-space-relations)/[ENG-2339](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-2339/import-cross-space-relations-into-obsidian).
* Choose an explicit retrieval trigger and its visible result before proposing the smallest implementation. Keep background polling undecided; the project excludes automatic remote-to-local polling from MVP0.

## Done When

* The origin app/vault, publishing space, group access and both endpoint identities are documented in a reproducible scenario.
* The owner records the chosen trigger, expected notification and duplicate handling, plus its place in the project scope.
* the reviewed draft distinguishes the own-node gap from merged imported-endpoint work and provides acceptance criteria for the chosen trigger.

## Out of Scope

* Implementing a fix, assuming the merged tickets are broken, automatic pull by default, or publishing relations.
* A new broad cross-space import ticket that duplicates [ENG-2338](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-2338/import-cross-space-relations)/2339/2340.

## Notes

* Open questions: Was the original failing destination Obsidian? Choose refresh-all, a dedicated check, or another explicitly scoped trigger. The source says “refreshes a node?” without deciding. Correct user-b/node-b references before reproduction.
* Existing work: [ENG-2338](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-2338/import-cross-space-relations)/2339 are Merged and explicitly exclude relations between two of the destination vault’s own nodes. [ENG-2340](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-2340/import-cross-space-relations-into-roam) is Merged and says Roam’s broad discovery can pick up own-page relations during later import/refresh. bxo-uDEeK already records Explore; no duplicate Linear candidate found in these searches.
* Sources: [https://roamresearch.com/#/app/discourse-graphs/page/KWwjT1Ihf](<https://roamresearch.com/#/app/discourse-graphs/page/KWwjT1Ihf>); [https://roamresearch.com/#/app/discourse-graphs/page/L9UkQcx9W](<https://roamresearch.com/#/app/discourse-graphs/page/L9UkQcx9W>); [https://roamresearch.com/#/app/discourse-graphs/page/4EmAoWvFk](<https://roamresearch.com/#/app/discourse-graphs/page/4EmAoWvFk>); [https://roamresearch.com/#/app/discourse-graphs/page/bxo-uDEeK](<https://roamresearch.com/#/app/discourse-graphs/page/bxo-uDEeK>); [https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-2338](<https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-2338>); [https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-2339](<https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-2339>); [https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-2340](<https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-2340>)
* Created with: dg-create-engineering-ticket, dg-engineering-writing-style.
---------------------------------------- COMMENT 2026-10-22 by siddharth yadav
Decision (Sid, 2026-10-22): Obsidian finds relations made elsewhere between its own nodes the same way Roam does, on every import and every refresh.

- Reproduction, from reading the code: once user A has imported anything, Roam's lookup covers every visible relation, while Obsidian's covers only the spaces of the nodes in that import (`fetchRelationInstancesForImport`). So Obsidian misses the relation whenever user A has imported nothing from user B's space. Roam misses it only when user A has imported nothing at all, because its refresh returns before the relation lookup when no imported node was refreshed (`refreshAllImportedNodes.ts:34`). Michael, can you confirm the 2026-10-08 report matches this?
- Notification: a notice says how many relations were imported.
- Duplicates: Obsidian already skips a relation whose source, destination and type it holds.
- Background polling stays undecided, since the project excludes it from MVP0.

Implementation: ENG-2427 (Ticket Draft) for Obsidian. The case where the user has no imported nodes at all, in both apps, is ENG-2428 in Product Decisions, with a proposed default of yes.

ENG-2429: Decide whether and when to build the cross-app fixtures and contract tests [Ticket Draft] assignee=None
---------------------------------------- DESCRIPTION
## Problem

* [ENG-1878](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1878/consolidate-mvp0-cross-app-fixtures-for-internal-validation) (one shared fixture set for Roam-origin and Obsidian-origin nodes) and [ENG-1879](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1879/add-automated-contract-tests-for-cross-app-shared-nodes) (automated contract tests for shared nodes) come from the MVP0 validation plan. The plan's other tickets, [ENG-1880](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1880/add-automated-relation-and-asset-validation-tests), [ENG-1881](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1881/document-manual-internal-qa-script-for-mvp0) and [ENG-1883](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1883/run-internal-mvp0-validation-and-capture-follow-up-issues), are in Icebox.
* Their approach isn't settled. On 2026-09-23 Marc-Antoine proposed correcting the example contract and building the fixtures first, then publish and import tests in each app, then one cucumber test that checks the upload and read shapes agree. On 2026-09-28 Michael asked to defer [ENG-1879](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-1879/add-automated-contract-tests-for-cross-app-shared-nodes) until Roam and Obsidian use the same contract code.
* [ENG-2143](https://linear.app/discourse-graphs/issue/ENG-2143/add-roam-and-obsidian-round-trip-tests) has since added Roam and Obsidian round-trip tests. Carries: `cross-space-relation-import` "Refresh with nothing imported". Verify: a `Decision:` comment records Michael's answer; if yes, the scenario holds in Roam and Obsidian.
- [ ] 4.3 [ENG-1866] Validate Obsidian relation export against the shared contract: close it. Carries: decision "Do we still need ENG-1866?" (no). Verify: the ticket is closed and no longer blocks [ENG-1874].

## 5. Upsert route, when someone picks up FEE-890

- [ ] 5.1 [FEE-890] Create a generic upsert route that accepts all root CrossApp types. First decide its open details (Michael). Carries: `graph-upsert-route` "The route takes CrossApp types…" and "The route identifies the caller from the plugin's own login"; the route decisions in `design.md`. Verify: nodes, relations and schemas can be written with a single call to the route.
- [ ] 5.2 [ENG-2005] Zod validators for the cross-app types. Carries: `graph-upsert-route` "The route checks the request body before writing". Verify: an arbitrary JSON object can be checked against the CrossApp types.
- [ ] 5.3 [FEE-891] Test the generic upsert route. Carries: decision "How do the route's tests run?". Verify: the route is tested, with a rejection case if 5.1 rejects incomplete payloads.
- [ ] 5.4 [ENG-1986] Refactor Obsidian sync to use the new cross-app schemas, before Obsidian moves onto the route. Carries: decisions "Is ENG-1986 a step of ENG-1823?" and "Which Obsidian fields must the CrossApp types cover?" (open, Marc-Antoine). Verify: Obsidian sync runs through the CrossApp converters without loss of functionality.

## Not covered by a ticket

- Moving Roam sync, Obsidian sync and Roam publish onto the upsert route. Tickets get created after [FEE-890] is built.
- Obsidian sync checking the per-row ids that `upsert_concepts` returns, and batching its call, as Roam sync does. Neither is in [ENG-1823] yet.
- Confirming that the 2026-10-08 report matches the code reading for [ENG-2394] (Michael).
- The relation fixtures [ENG-1863] promised. Only if a regression test is wanted.
- The two Roam relation converters in `conceptConversion.ts` that nothing calls. No ticket, by Sid's call.

## Workflow follow-up

- Michael and Marc-Antoine review the decisions on the tickets and in the two decision films.
- Sid then updates Linear: removes "blocked by FEE-890" from [ENG-1823] and [ENG-1824] and "ENG-1985 blocks ENG-1986", re-parents [ENG-1824] and [ENG-2061] under [ENG-2165], moves approved tickets to Architecture Refactors, closes [ENG-1866], and reviews [ENG-2425], [ENG-2426] and [ENG-2427] out of Ticket Draft.
